And now the news in detail.
The Festival of the Shaira, which marks the triumph of good over evil, is being celebrated
across the nation today.
Gracing the Shaira celebrations at IP extension in the national capital, Prime Minister Narendra
Modi hoped that all the institutions of the nation and all political parties stand
united for national interest.
He said, people must stand united to confront the enemies of the nation.
He said those who seek to harm the nation's honour, divide society and harbour hatred for
Indian culture are the enemies of the country.
He said nations should reaffirm resolve to identify the enemies of India and defeat them.
Mr Modi said, Vijay Dashmi celebrates the victory of good over evil and reminds everyone
of the enduring strength of truth and righteousness.

Speaking on the occasion, President Murmu extended her greetings to the nation.
She said that through Ramleela's organized across the world, many people remember the
principles and values of Lord Ram.
Foreign Affairs Minister Dr. S.J. Shankar held a trilateral meeting with UAE Deputy Prime
Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al-Nayan and U.S. Secretary of State
Marco Rubio in Mumbai today. He also held bilateral talks with both his counterparts,
more from our correspondent. External Affairs Minister Dr. Jai Shankar
held a trilateral meeting with his UAE and U.S. counterparts in Mumbai today evening.
In a post on X, Dr. Jai Shankar described the meeting as a useful exchange of perspectives
on energy connectivity and contemporary developments.
Dr. Jaishankar also held bilateral talks with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio.
The two ministers exchanged views on strengthening India-U.S. ties,
focusing on trade, energy, technology, defense, and people-to-people ties.
They also discussed regional issues, including the West Asia crisis.
Earlier today, Dr. Jaishankar met UAE Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister
Shreya Abdulabind Zayed Al Nahyan.
Speaking on the occasion, Dr. Jaishankar highlighted that bilateral trade has crossed
$100 billion since the signing of the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement.
Prasanna Akashvani, News, Mumbai.
U.S. Secretary of State Michael Rubio has called India an important and commercial partner and
business partner of the United States.
Talking to media in Mumbai today, Secretary Rubio said that India is a strong strategic partner
and a key member of the court.
He highlighted that India is the most populous country in the world and the largest democracy.
On India's role in meeting the world's energy demand, Mr. Rubio said India is a refining
superpower which has the capability to refine heavy crude.
Replying to a question on India purchasing Russian oil, Mr. Rubio highlighted that India
has repeatedly expressed the desire to diversify its energy portfolio and termed it a smart
thing to do.
External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar today said that India-U.S. ties have come a
long way and the partnership has steadily expanded, acquiring new dimensions and new facets
in the last few decades. Attending the celebration of the 250th anniversary of U.S. independence
in Mumbai as the guest of honour, Dr. Jaishankar cited Quad and Pak Sulika as some of the
notable examples of this partnership.
Defense Minister Rajnath Singh today emphasized that connectivity must be based on consultation
and respect for the sovereignty and territorial integrity of all countries.
Addressing the 25th meeting of the Council of Heads of Government of SCO in Dushanbeet,
Tajikistan, Mr Singh emphasized the importance of connectivity for shared prosperity.
He added that projects not founded on these principles will not be sustainable.
Mr Singh highlighted that India has built one of the world's largest startup ecosystems.
The Defence Minister called for unified action to dismantle the entire ecosystem of terrorism.
The India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement, or FTA, today came into force on the occasion
of Vijay Dasmi, a day symbolizing victory and new beginnings.
The agreement will provide duty-free access for 100% of Indian exports to New Zealand,
Addressing a ceremony on India-New Zealand free trade agreement in New Delhi yesterday,
Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Koyal said that the agreement is aligned with the
vision of Prime Minister Narendra Modi for Vixit Bharat 2047.
He highlighted that both the countries have agreed to work towards the goal of doubling
bilateral trade in goods and services with New Zealand to approximately 35,000 crore
rupees by 2030.
We have a report.
New Zealand has eliminated customs duties on all tariff lines covering
Indian exports, removing peak tariffs of up to 10%. Textiles,
apparel, leather, footwear, gems and jewelry, engineering goods,
automobiles and auto components, chemicals, pharmaceuticals,
agricultural products and processed foods are expected to benefit.
Duty-free access for wooden logs,
cooking coal and metal waste in scrap will further strengthen
manufacturing and MSME supply chains. The pharmaceutical and
medical device industries will benefit from streamlined regulatory processes. For the
first time, New Zealand has provided dedicated access in health and traditional medicine services,
covering Ayurveda, yoga and other Ayush systems.
So, Parna Sai Kya for Akashwani News, Delhi.

is for micro, small and medium enterprises.

Union Home Minister Amit Shah today met the family members of those who had been killed
in Punjab's Mansa and Gurdaspur recently for raising their voices against drug menace
in the state.
During his day-long visit, Mr. Shah also met the family of Gulzar Singh who had committed
suicide allegedly when his pleas were not heard by the state government against the sale of drugs
which made his son a drug addict. Later briefing media in Ludhiana the home minister said that
the situation of the family members has shaken him. He blamed the armed army government in Punjab
for protecting the drug traffickers. He said chief minister Bhagwan Thman that he would not
be able to handle other two cases also and hand them over to CBI as well. The home minister
promised to Punjab that the case of Parvinder Singh Jhota, which the Chief Minister handed
over to CBI today morning, will thoroughly be taken care of and none involved in this
episode will be spared. He assured that by December 2029 Punjab will be made drug-free
and those involved will be put behind bars.
I once again make a promise to the people of Punjab today that by 31st December
On December 29, we will eliminate the drug trade from Punjab, and anyone who makes an
effort to expand this trade will be put behind bars by the Narendra Modi government.
The Narendra Modi government will do the work behind the bars.
Manipur Police has apprehended three suspects to be involved in Monday's Nongshuam incident
in which three civilians were killed, while other three sustained bullet injuries when
the victims went to collect firewood.
Addressing a press conference at Police Headquarter in Impal this evening, additional Director-General
of Police Lahiri Doorji Lahatu said that a joint team of security force comprising Manipur
Police, Indian Army, Assam Rifles and CRPF Cobra conducted search operation in around
the incident place.
This is Aakashwani, you're listening to news at 9.
Indian railways today inaugurated the Tadoki, Ravghat and Abhanpur Kuruud broad gauge lines
in Chhattisgarh and flagged off new passenger train services connecting Raipur to Raugat
and Kurud.
The arrival of a train at Raugat for the first time since independence marks a historic milestone
in connecting the remote southern regions of the state to the national rail grid.
The events were held in the presence of Chief Minister Vishnu Dev Sai and Railway
Minister Ashwini Vaishnav, who joined via videoconferencing.
The 95-kilometre Dalli Rajhara Rao Ghat line, completed for Rs 1,628 crore, reached full
operational status with a 17.5-kilometre Tadogi-Ravgaard stretch.
The fifth joint military exercise of India and Australia, Austria-Hind, 2026 commenced
at Tiruvananthapuram.
The fourth edition was held at Irvine Barracks, Perth, Australia last year.
A report.
A total of 240 defence personnel are participating in the joint exercise.
Exercise Austrian 2026 aims to further strengthen military-to-military cooperation, interoperatability
and mutual trust between India and Australia.
It will reinforce their shared commitment to peace, stability and security in the Indo-Pacific
region.
For the first time, an observer delegation from New Zealand will also participate in the
exercise.
The joint exercise will conclude on November 1st.
Mithi M. Pallurithi, A.K.A.S.H, V.A.N.I.O.S, Thiruvananthapuram.
Minister of State for the Department of Atomic Energy, Dr. Jitendra Singh has said that
India's nuclear program is dedicated to peaceful purposes and not warfare, reaffirming
the country's vision for nuclear journey since its inception.
He said this in an exclusive conversation on the sidelines of Bloomberg
Economy Forum 2026 in New Delhi.
Millions of followers today paid homage to Bharat Ratna Dr. Baba Saheb Ambedkar
at Deeksha Bhumi in Nagpur on the occasion of 70F Dhamma Chakra Pravartan Day.
Addressing the main ceremony, venerable Vana Siri Mahathero from Myanmar said
that Dr. Ambedkar had embraced Buddhism not out of hatred for anyone
on, but because the dhamma of the Buddha offered humanity and the world a better society.
In Women's Cricket, India have set a target of 217 runs for Zimbabwe in the third and
final T20 international match of the series at Shaheed Veer Narayan Singh International
Stadium in Raipur.
In reply, Zimbabwe were 28 for two in 4.2 overs when reports last came in.
India continued its strong performance at the Asian Paragames in Aichinagoya, Japan
today, as India's medal tally has risen to 35, including 9 gold, 11 silver and 15 bronze.
Indians swept all the three medals in the men's discus throw, a 44-64 event.
